Situation

On sol 446 (Apr 2005) NASA's Opportunity drove straight into a wind-shaped ripple, dug its wheels in, and got stuck. Freeing it took weeks of Earth-side testing. Spirit hit the same soft-soil trap in 2009 and never escaped.
